# mathjs 15.2.0

Pinned upstream browser bundle, lazy-loaded only for calculator arithmetic.
Source: https://unpkg.com/mathjs@15.2.0/lib/browser/math.js
Project: https://mathjs.org/
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

The calculator restricts expression length, characters and AST operators before
evaluation. It does not expose variables, functions, assignments or units.
